definitions.full: H1342. gaah גָּאָה verb rise up (Aramaic Pe`al ( ᵑ7 1Sam 2:5 ) & often Ethpe`el אֶתְגָּאֵי , be boastful, proud , compare also Late Hebrew) — Qal Perfect ׳ג Exod 15:1 , 21 , גָּאוּ Ezek 47:5 ; Imperfect יִגְאֶה Job 8:11 ; 10:16 ; Infinitive absolute גָּאֹה Exod 15:1 , 21 ; — 1 rise up , of waters Ezek 47:5 . 2 grow up , of plants Job 8:11 . 3 be lifted up, exalted , of head Job 10:16 , of ׳י in triumph Exod 15:1 , 21 . גאה (probably √ of following; Biblical Hebrew גָּאָה rise up ).
